snippet.title: Takeoff over the valley | Hangar Valley
snippet.description:
Full throttle down the runway, lift off and climb out over the valley.

In-game footage from Hangar Valley, a calm VR flying game for Meta Quest. Your own hangar, a small plane and a quiet mountain valley.

Early access is coming to Meta Quest. Join the waitlist: https://hangarvalley.com
Roadmap: https://hangarvalley.com/roadmap.html

#VR #MetaQuest #flightsim
